_comment: ADR 0027 manifest — discoverability index. EVERY @lib.X.Y reference must resolve through here. Updated whenever a lib file is added/renamed. LLM authors read this file first to know what's available before composing.

entries.iso_top_down: Isometric 3D follow with 24m ortho extent, 0.18 lerp. Default for tactical / city / management games.
entries.top_down_3d: Camera directly above target, 16m ortho extent. farming-sim-style overhead.
entries.third_person_default: Behind-shoulder follow, mouse-yaw, perspective. Action-adventure / MMO.
entries.fps_default: First-person eye-height, mouse pitch+yaw, perspective. Doom / FPS feel.

entries.wasd_world: 4 rules: WASD → world-frame velocity_set (3 m/s). Iso/top-down/third-person modes.
entries.wasd_with_fp_variant: 8 rules: 4 world-frame (camera_mode != first_person_3d) + 4 camera-relative (camera_mode == first_person_3d). Bundles BOTH so V-cycle works.

entries.universal: ADR 0043 — the 4 universal WASD+Arrow movement actions (move_north/south/east/west, edge=hold) plus 3 engine-injected stop actions (stop_x/stop_y/stop). Every game's ui/input.json should $include @lib.input.universal.actions at the top of its actions array. Override per-game by re-declaring the same action name after the include — last-writer-wins.

shape_defs.camera_config: Dict — must contain {mode} + mode-specific fields (distance/ortho_size/eye_height/...). Spliced into scene.json::camera.
shape_defs.input_bundle: Dict {actions: [<inputs.json action>...], rules: [<rule>...]}. The `rules` array is spliced into a parent rules array via $include @lib.input_bundles.NAME.rules. The `actions` array is for documentation; per-game inputs.json still authors its own action list.
shape_defs.input_actions: Dict {actions: [<inputs.json action>...]}. The `actions` array is spliced into a per-game ui/input.json's actions array via $include @lib.input.NAME.actions. Each action is {name, edge, keys?, engine_injected?}.
shape_defs.entity_def: Dict {id, tags, properties, state_init, visual} matching entities.json def schema. Spliced into a `definitions` array via $include.
shape_defs.screen_spec: Dict {id, modal, freeze_world, background_color, elements, ...} matching screens.json schema. Spliced into a `screens` array via $include.
shape_defs.rule_array: Array of rule dicts. Spliced via $include into a parent rules array.

_authoring_discipline: When adding a new lib file, ALWAYS update this manifest's entries table. tools/validate_lib_refs.py checks every @lib.X.Y reference resolves through here AND that the lib file exists at the declared _path. Out-of-date manifest = sync failure.
